Seychelles
Consular help:Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in London, United Kingdom or bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Cairo, Egypt.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens:
Regular passport NO up to 30 days
Regular biometric passport NO up to 30 days
Service/Official biometric passport NO up to 30 days
Diplomatic biometric passport NO up to 30 days
Citizens of the Republic of Seychelles are exempted from visa requirement for entry, exit, transit and stay on the territory of Bosnia and Herzegovina up to 90 days, for a period of six months, starting from the day of entry.
